title: 黄仁勋韩国宣布：5000亿美元AI合作，韩国能否抓住AI黄金时代？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Jensen, I think we just start with the basics, like the career is incredibly important to the AI build out globally, we'll get into high ban with memory, but just from this summit, from the president being here, what is the takeaway, what is it you're trying to achieve?
segments.zh: 黄仁勋，我们从基础开始，职业生涯对全球AI建设至关重要，我们会谈到高带宽内存，但就这次峰会而言，总统也来了，你的收获是什么？你想达成什么目标？

segments.en: Well, we're announcing a whole bunch of partnerships with them. This is the golden ages for Korea, as you know. There's semiconductor businesses booming, they're industrial businesses booming.
segments.zh: 我们宣布了一系列合作。这是韩国的黄金时代，半导体业务蓬勃发展，工业业务也在蓬勃发展。

segments.en: This is a country that has the ability to help the world build out the AI infrastructure, that they're incredibly adapt at adopting new technologies, and is a really technologically forward-laning society.
segments.zh: 这个国家有能力帮助世界建设AI基础设施，他们非常擅长采用新技术，是一个技术前瞻的社会。

segments.en: And they love using AI, AI has really diffused throughout their society and their industry and so on.
segments.zh: 他们喜欢使用AI，AI已经渗透到社会和工业中。

segments.en: So this is a great time for them. We're announcing several things. We announce a big partnership with SK Group where our companies are going to enter into a business partnership where we do over $500 billion of business with each other, whether it's consumption and purchasing of memories, or selling AI supercomputers to them as they scale out to gigawatts of AI factories.
segments.zh: 所以对他们来说是个好时机。我们宣布了几件事：与SK集团的大规模合作，双方业务往来将超过5000亿美元，包括内存采购和销售AI超级计算机，以扩展至千兆瓦级的AI工厂。

segments.en: There's a whole bunch of other announcements. We're investing a billion dollars in neighbor to help, they're the Korea's leading AI cloud. They're going to scale up in Korea up to 200 megawatts, I think it is.
segments.zh: 还有其他公告。我们向Neighbor**10亿美元，他们是韩国领先的AI云服务商，将在韩国扩展到200兆瓦。
